findings.passage: “This validation tool enhances the speed and reliability of firearms transactions while protecting the privacy of concealed weapon license holders.” said Attorney General Drew Wrigley “It is a straightforward way for dealers to comply with state and federal requirements using the most current and accurate licensing data, always ensuring the rights and privacy of the holder.”
findings.note: Quote in his office's release announcing an online tool that lets gun dealers check whether a buyer's concealed weapon licence is active during a purchase.
subjects: concealed weapon licence used in gun purchase checks

findings.passage: “With this ruling, the Supreme Court has helped to rectify the wrongs perpetrated against the NRA by New York officials who appear to have abused their regulatory powers to threaten financial institutions that did business with a policy group they disfavored.”
findings.note: Statement in his office's release on the Supreme Court's NRA v. Vullo ruling, a free-speech case about a gun-rights group; the release also says he joined a 23-state friend-of-the-court brief in April 2024 backing the NRA.

findings.motion: Multistate attorneys general letter supporting the federal Second Amendment Enforcement Task Force
findings.note: He is one of the attorneys general listed as signing a letter to the U.S. Attorney General that backs the task force and promises state resources and support in Second Amendment litigation and in reforming federal gun rules. The letter text is a joint text led by West Virginia's attorney general, not his own wording.
